title: Update all edhoc_kdf callsites, transcript handling, and remove conflicting code in edhoc.rs
description: Fix callsites (lines ~638-752, 827+), make consistent with new KDF (prk, th, label, context, length). Resolve duplicate implementations visible in the file (one using u8 labels, another string). Ensure TH_2/TH_3/TH_4 computation matches Python.
close_reason: Verified against current code. Active build path: rust/lichen-oscore is a re-export shim of the external oscore crate ([patch.crates-io] rust/Cargo.toml:57 -> /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore); monolithic edhoc.rs was removed in commit 550cf41b06. (a) edhoc_kdf (external kdf.rs:53-107) encodes info = CBOR uint(label) || CBOR bstr(context) || CBOR uint(length), byte-identical to Python _edhoc_kdf (python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py:137-146); final signature converged to (prk, label:u32, context, length) in BOTH impls per RFC 9528 4.1.1, with TH passed via context (the intermediate (prk,th,label:&str,...) signature no longer exists anywhere). (b) All callsites match Python: KEYSTREAM_2 label 0 ctx TH_2 (initiator.rs:312-317, responder.rs:330-335 = edhoc.py:460,731), MAC_2 label 2 ctx_2=C_R||ID_CRED_R||bstr(TH_2)||CRED_R (initiator.rs:381, responder.rs:319 = edhoc.py:483-489), MAC_3 label 6 ctx_3=ID_CRED_I||bstr(TH_3)||CRED_I (initiator.rs:410, responder.rs:486 = edhoc.py:512-517), K_3/IV_3 labels 3/4 ctx TH_3 len 16/13 (initiator.rs:419-425, responder.rs:395-401 = edhoc.py:528-529), OSCORE export labels 7/10/0/1 (kdf.rs:115-135 = edhoc.py:557-563). TH_2 = H(bstr(G_Y)||bstr(H(msg1))) (transcript.rs:17-23 = edhoc.py:456, RFC 9529 2.2 vector OK); TH_3 = H(bstr(TH_2)||bstr(PLAINTEXT_2)||CRED_R) (transcript.rs:26-37 = edhoc.py:501-506,741); TH_4 = H(bstr(TH_3)||bstr(PLAINTEXT_3)||CRED_I) (transcript.rs:40-51 = edhoc.py:533-534,811-812; initiator binds plaintext captured pre-AEAD initiator.rs:436-446, responder binds decrypted plaintext_3 responder.rs:498). (c) No duplicates: zero edhoc_kdf occurrences in-repo; single kdf.rs+transcript.rs shared by initiator/responder; only other in-repo HKDF is provisioning.rs:296 (RFC 8613 BPSK, unrelated). Tests: cargo test -p lichen-oscore --features edhoc PASS (1 unit + 15 integration incl. test_transcript_2_matches_vectors and test_edhoc_exported_context_matches_vectors, full handshake+export vs Python-generated test/vectors/edhoc.json); external oscore crate PASS (100 unit + 9 integration incl. test_edhoc_interop_vectors), run read-only --locked. No in-repo files modified. Closed with open child uk36.3.4 (vectors/interop, P1) per task scope; no external-crate fixes needed.
